summary: Promote the plan-mode-first rule to users/cici/governed-state/voice/session-behavior.json so all three CLAUDE.md session behavior rules have canonical governed status.
rationale: CLAUDE.md Session Behavior defines three rules: (1) git_context_always_restate, (2) disagreement_limit_per_decision, and (3) plan-mode-first. Rules 1 and 2 were promoted to governed state via prop-20260413-001. Rule 3 — the default PLAN lane — was not promoted. This means the most consequential behavioral rule (never write without explicit permission) exists only in CLAUDE.md, which can drift. Promoting this rule to session-behavior.json gives it the same durability as the other two rules.
proposed_diff_summary: Added plan_mode_first as third rule in users/cici/governed-state/voice/session-behavior.json rules array.
decision_notes: Applied during skills assessment session. Rule live in session-behavior.json.
